# v1 importer golden fixtures: memory

GENERATED BY `go run ./internal/migration/golden`. DO NOT HAND EDIT.

Each `memory-<16 hex>.json` file is one record the real v1 memory importer produced from one digest-pinned input under `internal/migration/v1/testdata/v1-goldens/`, passed through the harvester's allowlist Redactor. The name is the first 16 hex digits of the sha256 of the file's canonical JSON (sorted keys, 2-space indent, LF, one trailing newline).

## Redaction policy

Each record holds the v2 file the memory FileStore wrote, read back. Frontmatter keys the importer and the FileStore batch set (format, name, kind, description, scope_ref, confidence, origin, session_id, created_at, updated_at, content_hash) and the body are kept; every other key is present with the value REDACTED. The importer's Change keeps operation, target and the body hash; source is the input-relative path.

## Regenerate

    go run ./internal/migration/golden [--domain memory] [--dry-run]

A repeat run over unchanged inputs writes nothing. To extend the input set, add the file under the pinned input dir, add its line to `INPUTS.sha256` (`<sha256>  <path>`, sorted by path), and run the harvester; it refuses any file the manifest does not list or whose digest differs.
